operations.label: Porphyrin 7: Make CdSe solution in a 500mL volumetric flask
operations.description: Source establishes concentration from UV absorption, then transfers solution to a round-bottom flask. Nominal20mg/500mL matches discussion0.04mg/mL; no derived molarity.

operations.label: Porphyrin 7: Slowly add one porphyrin solution by syringe pump
operations.description: Experimental section states7or8 as alternative ligand. Porphyrin amount is not specified here. Discussion gives2equiv and16h for8; this alternative is retained separately. This path selects only zn7; the other ligand is an alternative preparation, not a combined feed.

operations.label: Porphyrin 7: Restore total volume and acquire UV spectrum
operations.description: Transfer back to a volumetric flask after addition.

operations.label: Porphyrin 7: Remove most solvent under reduced pressure

operations.description: Centrifuge and repeat as necessary until UV spectra of washings are free of porphyrin; acetone volume unreported.

quality.review_scope: Admitted 13-page main paper only; scoped preparations and comparisons. Locally present screening-held SI excluded. No complete-paper or SI-reviewed claim.
missing_fields: No measured atomic coordinates or complete unit cell reported in the inspected main scope.
Detailed porphyrin precursor syntheses and SI luminescence/QY methods remain unreviewed because the local SI is screening-held.
Record/sample IDs distinguish source contexts, not independently established physical batch IDs.

conflicts: High-dilution8 discussion (main p.7) states16h and2equiv; experimental7/8 procedure (p.11) states24h at0.7µL/min. Alternatives are not averaged or silently reconciled.
